info.ideaText: Chat with others who are on the same page right now, like meeting someone in a shop who is into the same thing.
info.ideaPanelText: To chat with others on the same page, keep the panel open. When you close it, others will not know you are still there.
info.storageTitle: What we store on the server
info.storageIntro: The chat module does not store your IP address. We only keep what the chat needs:
info.storageUserSessionData: identity, normalized URL, display name, joined at
info.storageChatMessageData: url, sender identity, display name, text, timestamp
info.title: Your safety
info.safety2: Ignore those who try to hurt or provoke you.
info.safety3: Do not trust anyone, not even AI bots.
info.safety4: Never share personal information like your name, address, email, or phone number.
info.safety6: Don't leave anything behind that would make us have to send the police, Interpol, the CIA, or anyone else after you.
info.faq1: No login. Your pseudonym and profile are stored only in this browser.
info.faq2: Browser cache cleared? Your profile and nickname stay saved.
info.faq3: Extension reinstalled or app data reset? You start completely fresh with a new anonymous ID.
info.faq4: Incognito mode? Temporary session only, resets when closed.
info.faq5: All chat messages are automatically deleted after 72 hours.
info.faq6: Encryption? Yes. Your browser connects to our servers over TLS. It is not a secret chat: anyone in the same room can read messages; they stay on the server until automatic deletion.
info.faq7: Badge on the icon? The number shows how many people currently have WepChat open on this page and are in the chat room. We do not track which pages you visit. You only register for a room when you open the side panel.
